_about: The fix queue, seeded on 25 Oct 2026 by running the asset gate on every asset already placed in a zone (and the 2x kit's ground props). Most fail; that is expected. A queued asset may stay placed, and be redrawn and re-recorded, while it climbs out of the queue; remove its entry when it passes. New assets are never added here: they must pass (scripts/review/gate.py, docs/review-agents.md). On 26 Oct the scale gate (scripts/review/scale.py, sizes.json) added the assets whose size against a person, or whose ground grain against Eastward's, is out of range (docs/reviews/2026-10-26-scale.md).
